tei:div.tei:p: 549) ༄༅/ gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha snyan brgyud zab mo'i skor gyi zhi khro bsam gtan cho ga 'brel tshad rang grol bzhugs/ 550)

mi 'gyur bde chen ye shes che// rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje'i bdag /kun bzang bla ma dbyer med par// shes rab zab mo rtogs pas 'dud// zab gsang nor bu'i mdzod khang las// kun gyi phan bde'i rtsa lag dbyig zhi khro bsam gtan cho ga'i khrigs// brjod bde'i ngag gis spro bar bya/ 'dir rten gyi gang zag dbang thob dam tshig dang ldan pa zab lam 'di nyid la 'jug par 'dod pas/ rten gyis dkyil 'khor ras bris sam/ tshom bu'i dbus su rnam bum bcud ldan/ sman raka 551) gtor ma/ nyer spyod phreng tshar dang*/ las bum sogs 'og tu mkho ba'i yo byad rnams mngon par 'du byas nas/ thog mar brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ dmigs med zang thal kun bzang yab yum dang*// gtad med rgya yan rdo rje 'chang chen dang*// 'dzin med rang gsal rdo rje sems dpa' la// byar med klong yangs ngang nas gsol ba 'debs// gshis lugs ma bcos dga' rab 552) rdo rje dang*// yin lugs ma bslad shrī seng ha dang*// snang lugs ma 'gags pad+ma 'byung gnas la// gnas lugs ma bcos ngang nas gsol ba 'debs// stong nyid blo 'das mi 'gyur rdo rje dang*// sems nyid bsam 'das rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// chos nyid yul 'das yi dam dkyil 'khor lhar// de nyid brjod 'das ngang nas gsol ba 'debs// brgyud gsum rang rig don brgyud bla ma la// sgo gsum gus pas gsol btab byin rlabs kyis// mngon sum gong 'phel tshad phebs chos zad nas// sku gsum 'bras bu'i rang sa zin par shog skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo: bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: bdag dang 'gro ba sems can rnams: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed pa ni/ kye ma: bdag gis 'gro kun bsgral bya'i 553) phyir: rgyal ba zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i phyir: tshad med bzhi ru sems bskyed do:

yan lag brgyad pa ni/ rang rig lha la phyag 'tshal lo: ma 'gags rang gsal mchod pa 'bul: mu bzhir ltung ba mthol lo bshags: dus gsum mnyam nyid rjes yi rang: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par bskul: ka dag zang thal rjen par bzhugs: kun kyang rang rig rtogs par bsngo: sku gsum yongs rdzogs thob par shog: bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūm̐: bla ma'i byin rlabs mkha' la sprin ltar 'khrigs: yi dam lha yi dngos grub char ltar 'bebs: mkha' 'gro'i phrin las sgrub ba'i tshogs khang 'dir: bgegs dang bar chad 'da' ba'i skal ba med: oṃ sum bha ni= sogs/ srung 'khor ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phyi snod gzhal yas nang bcud lhar gsal ba'i: 554) phyi rol mtshon cha me ri'i gur khang 'khrigs: mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin lhun grub dbus: bskal pa'i bar du sra mkhregs brtan par gyur: badz+ra kro dha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: mchod pa byin brlab ni/ hūm̐: rgyal ba zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs rnams: snang srid thams cad yongs bkang nas: gus pas 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol: ma hā sarba pañca pū dza gā ṇa tsakra ho: lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: skye med chos dbyings zhing khams su: 'gags med thig le'i gzhal yas na: pad+ma zla ba'i gdan gyi steng: rang nyid rdor sems sku mdog dkar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje: thugs kar 'dzin cing g.yon pa yi: dril bu dkur brten zhabs sems skyil: sku la dar dkar na bza' gsol: rin po che yi rgyan gyis spras: snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo ru: 555) zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ni: rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs par bskyed: mgrin par rig 'dzin lha tshogs gsal: klad pa dung khang gzhal yas su: khrag 'thung 'bar ba lnga bcu brgyad: snang la rang bzhin med par gyur: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum du: yig 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las: 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros: 'og min gnas nas ye shes pa: dpag tu med pa spyan drangs gyur:

spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐: dpe med bsam brjod bral ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: bla ma rig 'dzin kun bzang chos kyi sku: longs sku zhi khro rab 'byams sprul 'khor bcas: rang snang gnas yul dag pas spyan 'dren no: rnal 'byor byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: bzhugs gsol ni/ hūm̐: sgyu ma gzugs brnyan chu zla 556)'ja' tshon ltar: 'od zer ye shes lnga ldan gzhal yas khang: sna tshogs rin chen pad+ma zla gdan la: rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ni/ hūm̐: yid chos rnam dag kun bzang yab yum sogs: rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: rang snang gnas yul dag pas phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: thun mong gi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: srid par gtogs pa'i mchod rdzas sna tshogs rigs: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: kun bzang mchod sprin nam mkha' gang ba 'di: kun bzang rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= sogs nas/ rū pa shap+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza āḥhūm̐: khyad par gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar sman gyi mchod pa dang: gu h+ya mu la rak+ta'i mchod pa dang: yab yum mkha' gsang bde ba'i 557)mchod pa rnams: kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul gyi bzhes: sarba pañca a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: sku ni mi 'gyur ka dag zang thal sku: gsung ni mi 'gags rang byung ye shes gsung: thugs ni mi g.yo bsam brjod bral ba'i thugs: kun bzang skye 'gags med la phyag 'tshal bstod: chos sku nam mkha' lta bur kun la khyab: longs sku nyi 'od lta bur so sor 'phro: sprul sku 'ja' tshon lta bur 'gro don mdzad: rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzlas dmigs ni/ kun bzang yab yum thugs ka ru// āḥdakar sngags kyis bskor ba las/

'od zer 'phros pas don gnyis byas// snod bcud yab yum 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dha tu āḥ oṃ ru lu 558)ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: zhes ci nus bzla/ mdun bum sgrub pa ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med bum pa'i nang: sku gsum dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs gsal: chos sku thig le nyag gcig la: longs spyaud rdzogs sku'i dkyil 'khor shar: sprul sku ma nges skur bzhengs la: dbang bskur rten du byin rlabs zhu: zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i lha tshogs rnams: 'gro don yid snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir byon: rnal 'byor byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol: du ma ro gcig brtan par bzhugs su gsol: rang snang gnas yul dag pas phyag 'tshal lo: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i tshogs: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: gus pa'i sems kyis 'bul lags na: 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: hūm̐: chos sku nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa las: longs sku nyi 'od 559)lta bur so sor 'phro: sprul sku 'ja' tshon lta bur 'gro don mdzad: rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: rang srog kyi sngags kyi 'od zer mchod pa'i tshul// 'phros te bum pa'i lha tshogs thugs kar zhugs// de dag sku las byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun// babs pas bum chur dbyer med ro gcig gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swa hā: zhes bzla/ las sbyor bsnyen pa ni/ sngags las 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ khams gsum thams cad snang bar byas// ngan song rnams sbyangs dmigs yul gtsos// sems can sangs rgyas zhing du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐/ zhes bzla/ las bum sgrub pa ni/ las bum nang du bcom ldan 'das// rdo rje sems dpa' gsal ba yi// sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas// bum pa mer gyis gang bar gyur/ yig brgya 560) ci nus bzlas mthar/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= sogs kyis mchod/ chos sku nam mkha'=

sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bum lha 'od zhu bdud rtsir gyur/ de nas phyag 'tshal pa ni/ e ma hoḥ phyogs bcu dus bzhi kun gyi bdag nyid che: bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro yongs rdzogs dgongs: 'dir gshegs nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: nyams chag na raka sbyang phyir phyag mchod bzhes: yon tan phun tshogs bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: dmigs med spros bral chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: 'gro mgon cir yang sprul pa'i sku la= gnas lugs mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku la= yang dag mngon par byang chub sku la: nyon mongs zhi mdzad zhi ba'i lha la= log lta tshar gcod khro bo'i sku la= thabs mgon tshe bdag 'jam dpal sku la= skyon bral 561)sgra sgrogs pad+ma gsung la= yang dag don ldan badz+ra thugs la= dug lnga nad sel bdud rtsi sman la= dregs pa 'joms mdzad phur pa'i lha la= 'byung ba'i mnga' bdag ma mo'i tshogs la= sa dang lam rdzogs rig 'dzin tshogs la= bstan pa srung mdzad dam can rnams la= dgra bgegs bdud 'dul sngags bdag rnams la= gang gis rgyal ba zhi khro yi: dkyil 'khor mtshan thos phyag 'tshal na: nyams chag ma lus kun byang na: mtshams med lnga la smos ci dgos: na raka gnas kyang dong sprugs te: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du grags: rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang sngags dngos: las sgrib nyams sgrib dag byed pa'i: 'khor ba dong sprugs yang snying bzla: oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma yaḥ sogs/ sa ma ya sa twa āḥ zhes bzla/ 562) 'gyod pas bshags pa ni/ hoḥ bde gshegs yongs rdzogs dgongs su gsol: rgyal ba'i bka' dang bla ma'i lung: ji bzhin ma spyad slob dpon smad: rdo rje mched dang lcam dral la: lta log ngan sems ngag tu smras: rdeg 'tshog gnod pa dngos su spyad: lha dang dkyil 'khor nyams ma gsal: dzapra bzlas ma dag zur chag nyams: gsang bar 'os dang gnyer gtad smras: gsang bcu bsgrags shing bla ma bslus:

rtsa ba'i dam nyams mthol zhing bshags: spyad par bya ba'i dam tshig lnga: shes bya lnga dang bsgrub bya lnga: mi spang lnga dang dang len lnga: yan lag dam nyams mthol zhing bshags: snyen sgrub ting 'dzin dam g.yel zhing: nya stong dus drug dus mchod chag: le lo gsog 'jog tshogs spyang byas: phud lhag nyams shing kha tshar shor: tshor dang ma tshor rkyen 563) dbang gis: sgo gsum bag med dam nyams bshags: lta ba'i klong bshags ni/ yid kyi dam nyams lta bas bshags: de yang kun gzhi byang chub sems: yin pa med pa'i lta ba rtogs: min pa med pa'i sgom nyams lon: yin min med pa'i spyod pa rtogs: re dogs med pa'i byang chub sems: rtsa ba yan lag thams cad kyi: chag nyams ma byung ma skyes pa: bshags bya bshags byed gnyis med grol: tshogs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: ram̐ las me 'phros dngos 'dzin bsregs: yam̐ las rlung byung bag chags gtor: kham̐ las chu byung gnyis 'dzin bkrus: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum 'od du zhu: bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gar gyur: nyer spyod kyi bskang ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan 564)dag na: lha rdzas mchog gi nyer spyod bdun: rgyu rkyen rnam par dag pa'i rdzas: bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'dis: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang: dam can rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: sman gyis bskang ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum snod kyi bhan+dha ru: rang rtsal bcud kyi bdud rtsis bkang : bskang ba'i rdzas mchog bla na med: bkram pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: rak+tas bskang ba ni/ hūm̐: 'khor lo lnga yi bhan+dha ru: thig le rak+ta bdud rtsis bkang : 'di yang rmad byung bskang ba'i rak+ta ste: bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol:

gtor mas 565) bskang ba ni/ hūm̐: gdal khyab pags pa'i gtor gzhong du: rus pa rang gsal dpal bshos btsugs: rang snang sha yi mtheb skyus sgron: bkrag dang gzi mdangs dza gad gsal: khrag dang chu ser rak+tas bran: bskang ba'i gtor ma bla na med: zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: mar mes bskang pa ni/ hūm̐: gdal khyab pags pa'i kong bu ru: khrag dang chu ser mar khus gtams: sha dang rus pa'i sdong bu btsugs: rang gsal bkrag mdangs sgron me sbar: 'di yang rang byung zhun mar te: bskang ba'i zhun chen bla na med: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: mar me'i smon lam ni/ hūm̐: dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: 566) sa bcu khyad par rim gyis bgrod pa'i tshe: nyon mongs bag chags ma lus der byang nas: 'gro don thogs pa med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis: sa bcu gcig char rdzogs par gyur nas ni: phyir mi ldog pa'i dngos grub thob par shog: tshogs spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐: sku gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: yi dam lha tshogs ma lus pa: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mkha' 'grau'i lha tshogs thams cad kun: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: chos skyong srung ma ma lus pa: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: nor lha dam can rgya mtsho rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: tshogs gtor 'di la byin gyis rlobs: rnal 'byor bsam pa sgrub tu gsol: 'bul ba ni/ rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: dgyes pa'i tshul gyis 567) bzhes su gsol: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa bshags: dam sri gnod byed zhal du bstab: gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+k-i ni gā ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: bskang ba ni/ hūm̐: khams dang skye mched gnas dag pa:

zhi ba'i lha tshogs klong du bskang: nyon mongs rtog tshogs gnas gyur pa'i: khro bo'i lha tshogs klong du bskang: mchod du med de gnyis med rol pas mchod: bskang du med de skye med ngang du bskang: sbyor du med de zung 'jug chen por sbyor: sgrol du med de mnyam nyid dbyings su sgrol: ye sbyor ye sgrol chen pos thugs dam bskang: tshogs drang ba ni/ ho: tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol: a la la ho: lhag ma ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma mo mkha' 'grau sha za dur bdag mo: lhag la dbang ba'i 'byung po 568) gtor len rnams: lhag ma 'di bzhes gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams: thams cad rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: dbang blang ba ni/ mdun bum gnas lnga nas 'phros thig le ni: dkar dmar mthing ser ljang gu bkrag mdangs can: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swa hā yis mtshan pa ni: rang gi gnas lngar thim pas dbang bzhi thob: rtsa sngags gsham du/ kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wāka sid+dhi ā: tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: sarba sid+dhi hrīḥ 'dir zur gsal gnas lung sbyar/ bskul pa ni/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ rnam dag chos dbyings khyab brdal klong yangs nas: kun bzang che mchog rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: mi mngon dbyings nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs la: log 'dren sems can 'dul ba'i grogs la byon: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

chad tho ni/ 569) hūm̐: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma yis: lha srin dam la btags pa rnams: sngon gyi dam las ma g.yel bar: rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: bstan ma ni/ hūm̐: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: bstan ma bcu gnyis dam la btags: bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar: rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las myur du mdzod: bro mnan ni/ hrīḥ chos dbyings ye shes chen po'i mkha' dbyings su: gnyis 'dzin rtog tshogs ma lus s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: hrīḥ zhi khro'i gar ni 'khor 'das dbyings su sgyur: kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i gdon tshogs thal bar rlog: rjes chog mchod bstod gong ltar bya/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rgyal ba zhi khro dngos grub gter gyi mdzod: dpal 'byor 570) longs spyod mnga' thang tshe dang chos: 'khor 'das rigs rgyud chos rgyud chu rgyun bzhin: thun mong mchog gi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ nongs bshags ni/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gsan cing dgongs su gsol: snyen sgrub zab mo dam du bcas lags kyang: ma rig ma rtogs tshod yod la sogs pa: 'khrul pa ci mchis dkyil 'khor lha la bshags: yig brgya dang dbyangs gsal brjod/ brtan bzhugs ni/ ye dharmā= sogs dang*/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu: 'khor ba srid du bzhugs nas kyang: nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang: mchog rnams legs par bstsal du gsol: oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra swa hā: bsdu rim ni/ snang srid ma lus rang gi sku la bsdu: rang nyid thugs ka'i sngags 'khor la thim 571) nas: de yang de dbus thugs srog āḥl thim: thugs srog āḥyang mi dmigs nam mkha' ltar: rgyun spyod ni/ hrīḥ bdag dang dam tshig ye shes gnyis med lha: nam yang mi gtong yun du brtan par bgyi: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐: bsngo smon ni/ hrīḥ 'dus dang 'dus byas kun rdzob don dam chos:

thams cad byang chub chen po'i rgyur bsngo'o: hrīḥ 'khor bar gnas pa'i sems can ma lus kun: ma lus phyam gcig sangs rgyas 'thob gyur cig: bkra shis ni/ hūm̐: sku gsum bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog: mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha'i bkra shis shog: gter srung dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: ces brjod pas dge legs su bya'o/ gnam la 'ja' 'od thig le'i sbubs// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba'i mthus// sa la mi 572) 'gyur rdo rje yis// zab gsang nor bu'i sgo 'phar phyes// mkhas grub karma chags med kyi/ bsam gtan cho ga dgos 'byung dbyig /rdo rje'i tshig rnams gung bsdebs pa'i// rgyun gyi nyams len dmar bcang gi /yan lag cung zad rgyas spros 'di// rang tshig dri mas ma sbags par// o rgyan dpal 'byor bzhed skong du// pad+ma nor bus bris pa dge ༈ zhi khro'i gnas 'dren shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs/ bla ma dang dbyer med pa rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ zhi khro'i gnas lung shin tu bsdus pa gtong bar 'dod pas/ sbyor ba'i skabs su dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i khar tshe 'das kyi ro'am/ gzugs ming nṛ yig bris pa'i byang bu dri rten dang bcas 'god/ sbyong chas/ brab rdzas/ zas gtad sogs nyer mkho rnams 'du bya/ cho ga dngos la/ dang po rten bskyed pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du 573)ming byang nṛ las tshe 'das kyi gzugs kyi rnam pa ji lta bar gyur/ rnam shes 'gugs pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka nas: hūm̐ las 'od 'phros tshe 'das rnam shes de: rigs drug gang na yod pa'i sa de nas: bdag gi 'od kyis reg ma thag tu ni: rnam shes nṛ de a dkar gcig tu gyur: mdun du bkug nas mtshan byang rten la bstim: dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song mthu rtsal dang:

sangs rgyas mthu stobs chen po'i byin rlabs dang: chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang: sngags 'chang rtse gcig bsgrubs pa'i byin rlabs dang: zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs thugs rje yis: lus med stong gzugs bar do'i rnam shes khyod: las dang nyon mongs dbang gis gar 'khyams kyang: dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pas 'dir khug cig: nṛ yaṃ dzaḥ 574) badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ a nṛ su tri pre du ma ma aṃ ku sha dzaḥ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya lhan: bgegs sbyong ba ni/ oṃ sarba bigh+nan= sogs/ lan gsum gyis zhi ba dang*/ sum bha ni= lan gsum gyis phyed ma dang*/ tshe 'das 'di la gnod cing 'tshe ba yi: sa dang lam la bar du gcod byed pa'i: srog gcod mdangs 'phrog gshed ma'i bgegs tshogs rnams: mthu stobs byin rlabs mthu yis gzhan du dengs: sum bha ni= sogs/ drag sngags dang tsham rngams kyis bgegs bskrad pa drag pos sbyong ba'o/ khrus bya ba ni/ hūm̐: 'di ni pha rol phyin bcu'i chu: nyon mongs dri ma sbyong mdzad pa: phar phyin bcu la legs 'god chu: phar phyin chu yis dag gyur cig: khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: yig brgya dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣi ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐: dug sbyong ba ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum: 'di dag 'jig rten 575)dug gsum ste: dkon mchog gsum po dug mi mnga': dkon mchog bden pas dug bcom mo: 'byung bzhi dug gi pha yin te: 'byung bzhi dug gi ma yang yin: bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas: dug rnams 'byung ba'i nang du song: gang ba'i snod du dug song ltar: khyod kyi dug ni dug med shog: dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang: ting 'dzin sngags kyi byin rlabs kyis: tshe 'das lus brjes bu khyod kyi: dug rnams gtan nas dag gyur cig: kaṃ ka ni= mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs brjod/ ༈ sbyor ba sdig sgrib dag byed kyi dbang ni/ e ma mgon po thugs rje can:

bdag sogs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las: skyob phyir brtse bas rab bzung nas: dbang dang byin rlabs bstsal du gsol: zhes gsol ba btab pas tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas 576) bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bkrus par bsam/ hūm̐: kun bzang yab yum bum pa na: rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs bzhugs: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: ngan 'gro'i skye sgo bcad nas ni: 'gro drug sdug bsngal bral bar shog: rtsa sngags dang yig brgya'i mthar/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: ces bkru/ rnam snang dang*/ mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs bzla zhing bye mas brabs pas ngan 'gror skye ba'i sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa sbyang bar bsams la/ rigs kyi bus tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyon mongs skal ba ngan pa dang bkra mi shis pa'i dngos po thams cad nye bar zhi ste shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig dngos gzhi'i yon tan bskyed pa'i dbang ni/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ e ma mgon po thugs 577) rje can: bdag 'dra'i sems can 'khor bar 'khyams: log pa'i lam du zhugs lags pas: bde chen thar pa'i lam ston 'tshal: dkyil 'khor chen por gzhug tu gsol: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams: tshe 'das bdag la dgongs su gsol: dkon mchog rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lhar: bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi: so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang : smon dang 'jug pa'i byang chub sems: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig kun: ma lus bdag gis yongs su bzung: tshe las 'das pa skad cig gis dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur/ zhi khro'i sngags dang*/ badz+ra a be sha ya a be sha ya a āḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ tiṣ+ṭha badze: hūm̐: bum pa 'di ni gzhal yas khang: nang na zhi khro'i lha tshogs bzhugs: phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang mchog

578) rnams: slob bu khyod la phab pa yis: phung khams lha dang lha mor gyur: bskyed rim lha dbang thob par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥswa hā: de ltar zhi khro rab 'byams 'dus pa'i rang bzhin ye shes drug gi chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang*/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes nyams su myong*/ dbang gnas su bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma 'khyil ba las rigs 'dus rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sa brtan cing shis pa brjod/ zas gtad pa ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: phyogs dus kun na gzugs sgra dri ro dang: reg bya'i khyad par dbang po tshim byed rnams: rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas thob khyod la 'bul: zag med dga' bdes rtag tu tshim par shog: oṃ pañca ka ma gu ṇa pra tī ts+tsha hūm̐ swa hā: smon lam gdab pa ni/ 579) thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin du// longs spyod zad pa med par shog /rtsod pa med cing 'tshe med par// rang dbang du ni spyod par shog lam bstan pa ni/ 'di nas phyogs bzhi dbus lnga na: mngon dga' la sogs zhing khams su: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rigs mchog lnga: gang zhig de yi mtshan 'dzin pa: zhing mchog der ni skye bar 'gyur: zhing mchog de ru skye bar shog: bcom ldan rgyal ba rigs lnga la: tshe las 'das pa 'di nyid kyi: phung po lnga po yon du 'bul: yon 'di bzhes la lam 'di ston: sems 'di byang chub gnas su drongs: gnas spar ba ni/ hūm̐: thabs kyi gzhu la shes rab mda' bkang ste: ye shes thugs rje'i shugs kyi rgyud dang ldan: bla na med pa'i gnas mchog dam par ru: tshe 'das mda' 'phangs 580)bzhin du skye bar shog: phaṭa: tshe las 'das pa'i rnam shes hūm̐ yig gi rnam pa rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams su thim pas rgyal ba'i sras su sangs rgyas par gyur cig: byang bu sreg pa ni/ hūm̐: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod kyi:

rnam shes tshogs brgyad thab khung du: phung po lnga yi bud shing la: ye shes lnga yi me sbar bas: nyon mongs rgya mtsho skems par shog: yig brgya sogs sgrib sbyong gi gzungs bzla bzhin pas bsregs pa'i thal bar sāts+tsha gdab cing*/ smon lam ji ltar rigs pa bya'o/ zhes pa'ang gnas brtan lo tsā ba bharma shrī dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsung rab las btus te/ gnas lung shin tu bsdus pa'i tshul du dpal chen 'dus pas bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel// maṅga lam//
